reader_summary.overview: This episode explains how investors can systematically outperform the market by finding high-quality companies sold at low prices. notes: In this episode, we reveal how individual investors can systematically outperform market averages by acquiring quality businesses at bargain prices. Through analysis of return on capital and earnings yield metrics, we explore how emotional market swings trigger extreme price disconnects. From single-pack gum economics with 80% net margins to 52-week price spreads exceeding 120% in major companies, we examine how these signals point to mispriced investment opportunities. We dig deeper into Benjamin Graham’s "Mr. Market" paradigm and the 10-year U.S. Government bond benchmark, analyzing the relationship between risk-free yields and equity valuations. You’ll learn about calculating earnings per share and intrinsic value discounts, how a 10% earnings yield provides a 400 basis point spread over the 6% hurdle rate, and what these reveal about structuring a margin of safety. You’ll understand how the rules-based Magic Formula strategy affects portfolio performance over multi-year horizons, why short-term market underperformance requires disciplined conviction, and what historical price volatility patterns suggest about investor behavior. From inflation risks in cash holdings to evaluating retail chain expansion potential, we break down complex ideas into practical takeaways. Whether you’re an investor, founder, professional, or someone interested in value investing and quantitative stock selection, this episode provides comprehensive insights into disciplined capital allocation and business evaluation rules. Learn how understanding these valuation metrics and price volatility patterns can help you buy high-quality businesses at bargain prices and maximize long-term returns. Ready to profit from Mr. Market's mood swings instead of falling for them? Press play and learn the two numbers behind the Magic Formula. POWERED BY KRESERA Loved this episode? Through analysis of return on capital and earnings yield metrics, we explore how emotional market swings trigger extreme price disconnects. From single-pack gum economics with 80% net margins to 52-week price spreads exceeding 120% in major companies, we examine how these signals point to mispriced investment opportunities.

 We dig deeper into Benjamin Graham’s "Mr. Market" paradigm and the 10-year U.S. Government bond benchmark, analyzing the relationship between risk-free yields and equity valuations. You’ll learn about calculating earnings per share and intrinsic value discounts, how a 10% earnings yield provides a 400 basis point spread over the 6% hurdle rate, and what these reveal about structuring a margin of safety. You’ll understand how the rules-based Magic Formula strategy affects portfolio performance over multi-year horizons, why short-term market underperformance requires disciplined conviction, and what historical price volatility patterns suggest about investor behavior. From inflation risks in cash holdings to evaluating retail chain expansion potential, we break down complex ideas into practical takeaways.

 Whether you’re an investor, founder, professional, or someone interested in value investing and quantitative stock selection, this episode provides comprehensive insights into disciplined capital allocation and business evaluation rules. Learn how understanding these valuation metrics and price volatility patterns can help you buy high-quality businesses at bargain prices and maximize long-term returns.
